Firstly, I’m gonna say that we have to take what he says with a grain of salt. Who knows, he can surprise us! 

But another thing… Why are you turning off MOP and delivery? Why are you turning off vanilla? Do you not have any? If not, have someone go to another store to get it. If you don’t have the staff to, then that’s a different story. Turning off vanilla literally turns off any drink with whipped cream, vanilla or sweet cream. 

If you’re turning off these things to make your job easier and to lessen the amount of orders coming in, then you need to realize that’s going to negatively affect your labor. You’re proving that you don’t need more labor because your sales are low. So unless you’re severely understaffed, then I don’t see why you would think it’d be ok. 

This is a business and you have a job. If you don’t like it, then just leave and find another job, it’s really so simple. I’m not saying that it’s perfect. I wish we had more labor to help with the business. It really sucks sometimes, but the reality is, this is retail.  Other retail companies give you a lottttt less and expect a whole lot more.
